_doc: Single source of truth for /compare/ pages. To add a new app: add an entry under `apps` with verified data only (no guesses), then add pairs to `pairs`. Run `node build-compare-pages.js` from repo root.

flipperhelper.name: FlipperHelper
flipperhelper.applicationSubCategory: Inventory and profit tracker for resellers
flipperhelper.tagline: Free iOS app for resellers — real profit tracking after every expense
flipperhelper.best_for: UK resellers sourcing at car boots, charity shops, antiques fairs, brocantes; multi-platform sellers; anyone who needs offline-first entry and per-trip profit grouping
flipperhelper.not_for: Android or web users; resellers who need built-in price research; resellers who need cross-listing
strengths: Real profit calculation after entry fees, transport, packaging, and platform fees
Hauls — group items by sourcing trip and track per-trip profitability over time
Offline-first — works at 6am car boots with no signal
Multi-currency (useful for sourcing in France or Belgium)
Three backup paths: iCloud auto, Google Drive images, ZIP export
Free, no ads, no account required
limitations: iOS only — no Android, no web
No marketplace API yet (manual sale-marking until eBay tier ships)
No built-in barcode scanner / eBay sold-price lookup

flippd.name: Flippd
flippd.applicationSubCategory: Inventory and profit tracker with price research
flippd.tagline: Multi-platform tracker with built-in price research
flippd.best_for: Resellers who need multi-platform support (iOS / Android / web), built-in barcode scanning, or eBay sold-price lookup before buying
flippd.not_for: Resellers under the 20-item lifetime free cap who don't want a subscription; resellers who need offline-first reliability at signal-free venues
strengths: QR label printing for inventory organisation
Available on iOS, Android, and web
Flat-rate pricing, unlimited items on paid tier
limitations: Free tier capped at 20 items lifetime (not monthly)
No cross-listing — same as FlipperHelper, it tracks only

vendoo.name: Vendoo
vendoo.price_free: Free tier: 3 new listings per month
vendoo.tagline: Push one listing to many marketplaces
vendoo.best_for: Resellers who list on 3+ platforms (eBay, Vinted, Poshmark, Mercari, Facebook Marketplace) and spend hours copying the same listing across them
vendoo.not_for: Resellers who want to know their real profit — Vendoo doesn't track expenses, mileage, or per-item profit
strengths: Create a listing once, push to multiple marketplaces
Auto-delists from other platforms when an item sells
Available on iOS, Android, and web
Tiered paid plans from $8.99 to $69.99 per month
limitations: Not a profit tracker — no expense tracking, no mileage, no entry fees, no real profit calculation
Free tier limited to 3 new listings per month
Different problem space from inventory trackers
